title: Martial Law Order 1962 Zone B No 110

sections.shortTitle: Martial Law Order 1962 Zone B No 110
sections.section: ORDER - Martial Law Order 1962 (Zone B) No. 110
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW REGULATION
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS
By
MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ZONE `B'
No.110
[31st January 1962,
Gazette of West Pakistan, Extraordinary, 6th February 1962]
In
pursuance of issuance of the Karachi Reconstituted Pasteurised
Skimmed Milk Consumption and Distribution Control Order, 1962, Martial Law
Order No. 42, Zone `A', is cancelled with effect from 15th January 1962.
